This '''portmaster's deputy''' was employed by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] on [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]], in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].

==Biography==
The portmaster's deputy was dispatched to install an [[impoundment-fastener]] on the [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]] of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] devised a plan to retrieve the [[molecularly coded key]] from him. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] created a three-way collision with the man, soaking him with liquor carried by Chewbacca. In the ensuing confusion and argument, Solo pick-pocketed the deputy. Not wanting a superior officer to catch him in this situation, the deputy hurried on his way.<ref name="Han Solo at Stars' End" />
